provenance: Accounts were issued out of band (docs/alpha-testing-guide.md §2); the person-to-account mapping lives in the feedback survey's 'Your name' answer (docs/user-feedback-survey.md:19-22).
userId is the User.id UUID, which is also the PostHog distinct_id (docs/analytics/alpha-tracking-plan.md:51).
wallets are the G-addresses each tester signed with, read from SignedTransaction.signerAddress or the transaction_signed event. A tester signs with more than one, so this is a list.
No real name, username or email belongs in this file. The labels are pseudonyms and the published pages use them.
note: Every alpha-tester figure is filtered on these UUIDs explicitly. The PostHog cohort named 'Alpha testers' is role = USER, which since the 16 September cutover also matches paiflow.xyz visitors (docs/analytics/alpha-tracking-plan.md:47-50); it is deliberately not used here.
